text: For a short exact sequence $1\to N\to G\to Q\to 1$ and a $G$-module $M$, the $E_2$ page of the Lyndon-Hochschild-Serre spectral sequence is:
explanation: The LHS spectral sequence reads $E_2^{p,q}=H^p(Q,H^q(N,M))\Rightarrow H^{p+q}(G,M)$: the outer cohomology is over the quotient $Q$ and the inner over the normal subgroup $N$. Swapping $N$ and $Q$ or using $G$ itself is wrong, and the tensor-product form is a Kunneth-style expression, not the LHS $E_2$ page.
